payback_policy.note: Per POL-TAX-002 & FM-PAYBACK-V1. Tiered thresholds: <=2.0Y = approve; 2.0-5.0Y = staged/IPS-dependent; >5.0Y = reject. Configurable via IPS. Used by GATE-8 (release_gates.py).

new_sip_allocation.note: All new SIP capital goes to debt/liquid. Capital preservation only.

low.description: Tier 1 (SEBI Low): Capital preservation focus. Minimal equity exposure. Suitable for horizon < 3 years or ultra-conservative mandate.

new_sip_allocation.note: SIP primarily to debt/liquid with modest equity for inflation protection.

low_to_moderate.description: Tier 2 (SEBI Low to Moderate): Conservative income focus. Limited equity for inflation hedge. Suitable for horizon 3-5 years.

new_sip_allocation.note: Balanced SIP allocation across equity and debt sleeves.

moderate.description: Tier 3 (SEBI Moderate): Balanced growth (DEFAULT). Moderate equity with debt buffer. Suitable for horizon 5-7 years.

new_sip_allocation.note: SIP primarily equity with small debt reserve for rebalancing.

moderately_high.description: Tier 4 (SEBI Moderately High): Growth-oriented. Higher mid/small allocation. Suitable for horizon 7-10 years.

new_sip_allocation.note: SIP overwhelmingly equity. Minimal debt for emergency reserve only.

high.description: Tier 5 (SEBI High): High-conviction alpha. Aggressive mid/small exposure. Suitable for horizon 10+ years.

new_sip_allocation.note: All new SIP capital goes to equity. Existing debt holdings maintained for rebalancing ammunition but receive no new SIP inflows. Requires explicit IPS authorization.

very_high.description: Tier 6 (SEBI Very High): Maximum-risk mandate. 95% equity ceiling. Highest volatility tolerance. Suitable only for horizon >= 10 years with explicit IPS authorization.

starter_flexi_sleeve_cap_exception.condition: Starter heuristic (< INR 5L AUM) permits single core Flexi fund up to starter sleeve weight before portfolio reaches established threshold.

established_sleeve_cap_exception.condition: Permits core sleeve allocations up to 35% when strategic asset allocation targets in behavioral_risk_profiles dictate single-fund sleeve weights exceeding 20% prior to multi-fund sleeve expansion.

sip_allocation_policy.plan_migration_note: Switching Regular to Direct within the same scheme (same ISIN family) is a plan migration, NOT a new fund introduction. It does not count against max_new_funds_per_12_months.

very_high_sip_routing.note: For VERY_HIGH (Tier 6), route 100% of SIP to equity when explicitly authorized via IPS. Requires explicit investor policy authorization per REQ-ARCH-006. When disabled, follow standard dual-track budgeting per REQ-ARCH-006.

fund_universe_requirements.note: A meaningful 5-pillar screen requires at least 30 candidate funds across categories. Below 30, flag UNIVERSE_INSUFFICIENT and expand search via AMFI scheme code catalogue before issuing recommendations.

withdrawal_policy.note: 4% withdrawal rule with 6-month liquidity reserve. Tax-optimized lot selection (lowest realized gain first) to minimize capital gains impact. Per POL-SWP-001.

glide_path_policy.note: Default DISABLED until investor opts in. Per POL-GLIDE-001. Each de-risking step requires investor + adviser sign-off. No taxable event without tax review. If declined -> GLIDE_PATH_DECLINED documented.

international_gold_policy.note: For MOST_AGGRESSIVE: international 10% (US feeder), gold 5% (SGB/ETF) per market-standard tolerance. FX disclosure mandatory. Per POL-GEO-001.

review_policy.note: Per POL-REVIEW-001. Overdue -> REVIEW_OVERDUE flag, SIP to liquid until acknowledged. Stale data -> REVIEW_BLOCKED_STALE_DATA.

goal_achievement_policy.note: Per POL-GOAL-001. At target: stop SIP, shift 80% to debt/liquid, retain 20% equity. Freed SIP -> next priority goal. Shortfall/surplus flags at 12 months out.

very_high_override.note: For VERY_HIGH (Tier 6) with horizon >= 7 years, reduce parking to 20% and increase STP equity deployment to 80%. Full lumpsum equity deployment permitted only with explicit client acknowledgment of sequence-of-returns risk.

policy_interpretation.saa_targets: Strategic asset allocation targets for the total portfolio; not the same as new-SIP cash-flow routing.
policy_interpretation.new_sip_allocation: Base allocation of new monthly SIP cash flows when the stability-buffer override is not met.
policy_interpretation.stability_buffer: May alter new-SIP routing only under the documented formula and verified exposure data; it does not rewrite the investor's SAA target.
policy_interpretation.age_and_horizon_guidance: Age and horizon bands are non-binding review prompts, not automatic equity caps. Determine risk capacity from goals, liabilities, income stability, liquidity needs, loss capacity and investor-specific facts.

thematic_satellite_policy.funding_rule: Carve the satellite percentage out of the equity SIP budget before allocating the remainder across core sleeves. Never add it on top of core weights.
thematic_satellite_policy.no_candidate_rule: If no separately verified thematic candidate passes, keep satellite at zero; do not automatically redirect its budget.

custom_saa_policy.note: When custom SAA specifies total equity without explicit sub-sleeves, this policy distribution is used.

starter_portfolio_routing.rationale: A simplified two-core-sleeve routing for smaller portfolios; review when AUM or monthly SIP exceeds either threshold. Not a statutory or universal rule.

default_saa_distribution.note: Default fallback when no SAA is provided (represents 50% Large Cap, 25% Mid/Small, 0% Flexi, 25% Debt)
